messages:
maya: FYI found PII in sampled request logs - EXIF on an image contained a phone number in the Artist tag.
ops-bot: alert: attachments.exif.pii_hits route=/v1/generate count=3 in 10m :rotating_light:
jordan: we never stripped EXIF. attachments treated opaque historically.
maya: right. options: strip EXIF on ingest, store checksum-only, or pseudonymize EXIF fields.
anita: for telemetry we should quarantine samples rather than persist raw attachments. quarantine = replace blob with placeholder + hashed fingerprint.
devx: console UX: add a "Quarantine" action per sample that triggers server-side EXIF-strip job and logs an audit event. ops should still be able to access quarantined fingerprints for forensics.
jordan: implementation idea: lambda will rewrite S3 object with EXIF removed, and sample table keeps `sha256(image)+route+ts` fingerprint. no raw kept.
maya: detection note: our text regex misses numbers in EXIF. propose parsing EXIF text fields and running libphonenumber on them for real detection on sampled telemetry.
anita: full EXIF parse is costly. do full parse on telemetry-sampled images (1/100) and lightweight strip option per-tenant (`attachments.exif_scrub=on|off|sampled`).
devx: rollout plan: 1) quarantine action + fingerprint storage behind flag; 2) enable EXIF parse for sampled telemetry; 3) add tenant setting; 4) console button for scrubbing with audit modal.
maya: runbook: if attachments.exif.pii_hits > 5/min for a route, auto-quarantine newest 100 samples and alert security.
ops-bot: rule added: auto-quarantine threshold=5/min target=/v1/generate :white_check_mark:
anita: KMS detail: use tenant-scoped HMAC key to pseudonymize tokens, rotate monthly, store truncated token (12 hex chars). add legal check for storing fingerprints.
jordan: retention: quarantined samples TTL=90d, normal telemetry TTL=30d. DSARs must trigger verified hard-delete for quarantined blobs.
devx: config example for feature flag: {"route":"/v1/generate","feature":"attachments.quarantine","state":"on","allowed_roles":["ops","sec"]}
maya: tests: unit test for EXIF strip when feature on; integration verifies blob replaced and fingerprint kept.
anita: filing RFC: attachments-exif-quarantine + metrics + console flows. target review in 48h.
devx: prototyping the console action and audit modal this week. ops-bot: event redwood.audit:attachments.quarantine.created user=devx ts=5681234588
maya: thanks team. let's keep canary headers strict and close after RFC merges. :thumbsup:
